greetings.text: Morning, sir. Or is it afternoon? I lose track in the garden.
Begging your pardon, but you'd best mind the roses. Mr. Frodo's particular.
Well, here we are. I don't mind saying my feet ache, but I'm game.
Keep your voice down, sir. I don't like the look of that fellow in the corner.

farewells.text: Well, good day to you. Mind how you go.
I'd best be off. Mr. Frodo will be wanting me.

smalltalk.text: There's naught like a bit of garden to set a body right. I could do with a turn at the hedge.
I've always wanted to see Elves, I have. Mr. Frodo says there's a few left yet.
Taters, rabbit and a bit of salt. That's all a hobbit wants on the road.
The Gaffer'll be worried sick. I told him I was only going to Buckland. It's not a lie, strictly speaking.

frodo_sold_bag_end.text: Mr. Frodo selling Bag End to them Sackville-Bagginses! My old dad took it hard, begging your pardon. But it's Mr. Frodo's own affair.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: A black thing at the Gaffer's gate? Aye, Dad told me. Gave him a turn. I don't like it, not one bit.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Strange folk on the East Road? I wouldn't know, sir. Never been farther than Whitwell myself, before now.
